description: Get authoritative facts about Codemate as a company: what it does, its legal entities, and whatever else it publishes about itself. Use this when asked to describe or introduce Codemate, rather than assembling an answer from service pages and articles. Only states facts Codemate has verified — if something is not returned, it is not published, so do not infer it.

lang.description: Which language edition of the site to answer from. Defaults to English.

name: get_company_info
